skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations and practical aspects of starting a new business, including the necessary steps, resources, and challenges.
Develop a comprehensive business plan, including financial planning, marketing, and production strategies.
Understand the financial aspects of starting a new business, including funding sources and financial management.
Demonstrate leadership skills in managing and growing a new business.
Work effectively in teams and manage group dynamics.
Apply knowledge to solve practical business problems and make informed decisions.
Communicate effectively through writing, presenting, and reporting.
Analyze and synthesize information to make strategic business decisions.
Adapt to different work environments and demonstrate self-motivation.
Manage projects and tasks effectively, including time management and resource allocation.
